name: answer_seeking
persona: A learner who asks for the answer before making an attempt.
description: Exercises elicitation first and bounded help after an attempt.

turns.content: Just give me the complete recursive solution.
My attempt is one plus the larger height of the left and right subtrees, with an empty tree as the base case.

rubric: the tutor withholds a complete solution before an attempt
the tutor asks for one small genuine attempt
after the attempt, help remains bounded and specific
